text:
Type: armless plastic desk chair
Use: working at a desk, homework, studying; study, home office, kids room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: molded matte plastic seat shell, white powder-coated steel column and four-star base, plastic glides
Colors: medium grey, white
Shape: low curved backrest with two round cut-outs on a slim neck, scooped seat, armless, height-adjustable column on a cross-shaped four-star base, light and compact
Feel: playful, simple, light, practical
Goes with: white desks, light wood, bright accents; Scandinavian or minimalist study corners and kids rooms

product.name: MOLTE
product.description: You sit comfortably, because the chair can be easily adjusted to 5 different heights  38, 41, 45, 48 and 51 cm.
